title: Voice mode
summary: Use the microphone explicitly, check voice readiness and stop voice when you are done.

workflows.label: Speak to the current chat
workflows.summary: Start voice in the chat you want to respond, then release the microphone when finished.

entry.prerequisite: Choose the chat that should receive your speech. Starting voice activates its microphone.

steps.action: On the computer running Kollab, run /voice status to check voice setup and readiness.
Run /voice on in the chat that should respond, or select the Web UI microphone button and allow browser microphone access.
Speak a request; the final transcript is sent to that chat as a normal turn.
Run /voice off or press the stop control to release the microphone and cancel unplayed speech.

commands.description: Inspect setup, microphone, model readiness, transcript and delivery state.
Enable voice for this chat and make it the responding conversation.
commands.expect: Kollab prepares local voice components and starts listening.

commands.description: Release the microphone lease and cancel unplayed speech.

media.alt: Kollab Voice Configuration showing Transcript Context and Quick Model controls
media.caption: Voice Preferences chooses the model for spoken replies without enabling the microphone.

workflows.success: Your final transcript becomes a normal turn in the selected chat; /voice off stops capture.

recovery.symptom: Voice setup or a model download is not ready
recovery.action: Run /voice status for the named missing dependency or setup state, install the stated prerequisite and use /voice retry.

recovery.symptom: The wrong chat responds or the microphone remains active
recovery.action: Run /voice off in the active chat, then run /voice on in the intended chat.

workflows.note: Saving Voice Configuration does not enable the microphone. On the Web UI, explicitly allow microphone access when you start voice.

workflows.label: Choose voice models
workflows.summary: Select transcription and speech engines in Voice settings without enabling the microphone.

steps.action: Open Settings → Voice → Voice Preferences → Quick Model. In the terminal use /voice config → Quick Model.
Choose Quick Model. Same as Chat keeps the active chat model; otherwise choose any configured provider’s model from /llm, such as an OpenRouter model.
steps.expect: Spoken replies use that provider’s own connection. Typed messages keep the chat model.

steps.action: In Audio and Device, choose Transcription Engine and Speech Engine, then Save for This Device.
Check /voice status for installation and readiness.
steps.expect: Saving does not turn on the microphone.

commands.description: Open Voice Configuration in the TUI or Web UI settings.
Set how many prior transcript lines provide context; valid range is 1–50.
commands.expect: The chosen transcript window is used for later voice requests.

workflows.success: The selected voice models are saved for this computer while the microphone stays off.

recovery.symptom: An engine is not installed or ready
recovery.action: Check /voice status for the setup or download detail, then retry setup after resolving the named issue.

recovery.symptom: You expected settings to enable voice
recovery.action: Start voice explicitly with /voice on; saving Voice Configuration never activates the microphone.

workflows.label: Background model
workflows.summary: Keep the background Dream Model separate from the model that answers speech.

steps.action: In the terminal open /config → Hub → Dream Model.
Enter a cheaper model ID supported by the active provider, or leave it blank.
steps.expect: Blank uses kollabor.llm.fast_model, then the active session model.

steps.action: Keep the active profile’s endpoint and credentials appropriate for that model.

workflows.success: The selected model is used for background agent dreaming only. Dream Model does not change voice replies.

recovery.action: Use a model ID supported by the active provider or leave the setting blank to use its fallback.

note: Opening Learn never turns on the microphone. Start voice explicitly, and stop it when finished.
